设计意图： This factor captures the delayed adjustment between volatility, volume, and returns. Lagged 5-day return is multiplied by log volume ratio (to emphasize unusual volume) and amplified by the current volatility level (ATR/close). The EMA5 smoothing models the gradual incorporation of information into price, representing lagged response. The combination targets stable rank ordering across IC, RankIC,

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-(ewm_mean(5, (close/shift5 - 1) * log(volume/ewm_mean(volume, 20)) * (1 + ATR20/close)))

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(ewm_mean(5, (close/shift5 - 1) * log(volume/ewm_mean(volume, 20)) * (1 + ATR20/close)))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ewm_mean —— 指数加权均值
    ewm_mean(multiply(multiply(subtract(divide(close, shift5), 1), log(divide(volume, ewm_mean(volume, 20)))), add(1, divide(ATR20, close))), 5)
  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(multiply(subtract(divide(close, shift5), 1), log(divide(volume, ewm_mean(volume, 20)))), add(1, divide(ATR20, close)))
  3. 3. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(subtract(divide(close, shift5), 1), log(divide(volume, ewm_mean(volume, 20))))
  4. 4. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(close, shift5), 1)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(close, shift5)
  6. 6. log —— 取自然对数
    log(divide(volume, ewm_mean(volume, 20)))
  7. 7. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(volume, ewm_mean(volume, 20))
  8. 8. ewm_mean —— 指数加权均值
    ewm_mean(volume, 20)
  9. 9. add —— 加法
    add(1, divide(ATR20, close))
  10. 10. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ATR20, close)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ewm_meanEMA 指数移动平均

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 high：high
  4. 计算 low：low
  5. 计算 lag_ret_5：close / close.shift(5) - 1.0
  6. 计算 vol_ema：volume.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
  7. 计算 vol_ratio：np.log(volume / vol_ema)
  8. 计算 tr：pd.DataFrame({hl: high - low, hc: (high - close.shift()).abs(), lc: (low - close.shift()).abs()}).max(axis=1)
  9. 计算 atr：tr.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  10. 计算 vol_factor：atr / close
  11. 计算 raw：lag_ret_5 * vol_ratio * (1.0 + vol_factor)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_vol_lag_ret_smoothed(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] "com"># Lagged 5-day "kw">class="kw">return lag_ret_5 = close / close.shift(5) - 1.0 "com"># Log volume ratio relative to 20-day EMA vol_ema = volume.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean() vol_ratio = np.log(volume / vol_ema.replace(0, np.nan)) "com"># ATR / close as volatility measure tr = pd.DataFrame({"str">'hl': high - low, "str">'hc': (high - close.shift()).abs(), "str">'lc': (low - close.shift()).abs()}).max(axis=1) atr = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() vol_factor = atr / close.replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Combine: lagged "kw">class="kw">return * log volume ratio * (1 + volatility factor) raw = lag_ret_5 * vol_ratio * (1.0 + vol_factor) "com"># Smooth with EMA5 to capture delayed adjustment df_copy["str">'factor_vol_lag_ret_smoothed'] = raw.ewm(span=5, min_periods=5).mean() "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_vol_lag_ret_smoothed']
